propositions: Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows fail to price when stored with provider-qualified model_ref (e.g., 'anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6', 'openai:gpt-5.4') because genai-prices cannot resolve the prefixed id format
Bedrock rows price successfully with their provider prefix, creating an asymmetric cost comparison that falsely suggests Bedrock is the only measured provider arm
LookupError from unresolvable model_ref is caught silently at usage_log.py:429 and converted to 'unpriced' with no warning, making the failure indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models

The id translation must use registry membership (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES) rather than string splitting, because blind first-colon split would break versioned AWS ids like 'anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0'
Cost reporting in both CI matrix and local rebar usage output is affected, with the 'est. cost excludes N unpriced calls' line appearing even when all models are known to genai-prices
The fix must maintain the best-effort LookupError policy so pricing never breaks summarize, while making genuinely unknown models visibly distinguishable from mis-formatted ids
